title: Read-only tap-target size findings on HTML usability scan
description:
# Read-only tap-target size findings on HTML usability scan

Next slice of LIM-e872b1. Extends the existing `limatus usability scan` — do not add a new top-level command.

## DoD

- Same CLI: `limatus usability scan --page FILE.html --profile FILE.yml`
- New finding kind: `small_tap_target`
- Profile: `tapTarget.minPx` (CSS pixels, default **24**, WCAG 2.2 Target Size Minimum). Reject unknown keys. Existing `contrast.minRatio` must keep working; a profile with only `contrast` still loads (tap-target default applies).
- Interactive elements this slice: `a`, `button`, `input` (except `type=hidden`), `select`, `textarea`, `summary`, and any element with `role="button"` or `role="link"`.
- Size from (1) `width`/`height` HTML attributes on the element (px or unitless numbers), (2) inline `style` width/height, (3) the same single `<style>` simple `tag` / `.class` / `#id` rules already used for contrast. No layout engine, no viewport, no ancestor box model.
- Flag only when **both** width and height are resolvable **and** either dimension is below `minPx`. If either dimension is unknown, skip (no invented 300x150 img defaults, no “inline is auto”).
- CSS lengths: `px` and unitless numbers only. Skip `%`, `em`, `rem`, `vw`, `auto`, `fit-content`.
- JSON: same envelope as today; `small_tap_target` includes numeric `width` and `height` (and `selector` + `rationale`). `missing_alt` / `low_contrast` unchanged.
- Read-only; no rewrite keys; void-tag parser must stay correct.
- Tests: page with a 16×16 `button` (inline or CSS) that flags; a 24×24 (or larger) control that does not; unknown-size `<a href>` with no width/height must **not** flag; existing both-findings + minimal fixtures still pass.
- `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q`

## Out of scope

- spacing/offset exceptions from WCAG 2.5.8
- focus rings, overflow, template-tells, decide/options/apply
- SKILL.md
- live URLs / screenshots

## Layout

- Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-tap-target` from `origin/main`
- Branch: `feat/LIM-<this-id>-usability-tap-target`
- PR target: **main**. Prefix LIM.

## Inversion

- Sparse pages with unsized links must stay clean.
- Do not treat missing CSS size as “too small.”
